# serverguard24_check (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Serverguard24 check by `id`.

~> **API limitation:** The API has no bulk-list endpoint for checks (`service_show` accepts only an id), so lookup by name is not supported. Only top-level identifying fields are exposed; the type-specific `params` block is not surfaced. Use the `serverguard24_check` resource if you need round-trip management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note: The serverguard24_check data source only supports lookup by ID
# due to API limitations. Use the serverguard24_check resource for
# managing new checks.

data "serverguard24_check" "example" {
  id = "12345"
}

output "check_address" {
  value = data.serverguard24_check.example.address
}

output "check_shortname" {
  value = data.serverguard24_check.example.shortname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Check ID.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether monitoring is currently active.
- `address` (String) Address override (if any) for the check.
- `description` (String) Long description of the check.
- `notification` (Boolean) Whether notifications are currently enabled.
- `shortname` (String) Short display name of the check.
- `type` (String) Check type name (e.g. `http`, `ping`, `ssl_cert`).
